data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterwiesen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024, calculating a refund of €425.00 to be paid into Anton Musterschmidt's account, and giving him a one-month window to file an objection (Einspruch) if he disagrees with the calculation.
data.explanation: This letter is the tax office's final calculation of your 2024 income tax. Based on your return, they determined you overpaid and will refund €425.00 to the account you gave in your tax return - no action is needed to receive it. If you think the calculation is wrong (for example about deductible expenses), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows until when, based on the date the letter is deemed delivered. If you take no action, the assessment becomes final after that window.
data.tax_note: This is the official 2024 income tax assessment itself; keep it for your records as proof of the tax calculation, including the accepted Handwerkerleistungen deduction for the window replacement labour costs.

remedy.period_text: Für den Einspruch haben Sie einen Monat Zeit
remedy.form_text: schriftlich, über ELSTER oder dort zu Protokoll
remedy.quote: Halten Sie die Festsetzung für unzutreffend, können Sie beim Finanzamt Musterwiesen Einspruch einlegen, und zwar schriftlich, über ELSTER oder dort zu Protokoll.

key_facts.label: Objection period
key_facts.quote: Für den Einspruch haben Sie einen Monat Zeit; die Frist läuft ab dem Ende des Tages, an dem der Bescheid als bekannt gegeben gilt.

items.title: Object to the tax assessment if you disagree (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the tax calculation, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterwiesen, in writing, via ELSTER, or recorded in person at the office.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final and you lose the right to challenge it.

items.action: No action needed; the refund is paid automatically into the bank account you stated in your tax return.
